summary: The source is an SRS (v2.0) for Project Aegis, a web-based credit card management system consisting of a browser portal (React SPA) and a REST API (Node/Express) with a PostgreSQL backend. It specifies API/portal base URLs, authentication (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE) and token rotation, a 3-step credit application flow using a session_token and localStorage autosave, transaction initiation and transaction history APIs including a foreign transaction fee formula, account summary and card controls (freeze/unfreeze, lost/stolen, set PIN), statement retrieval and billing/rewards calculation rules, plus security/compliance and non-functional requirements (masking, rescind window, PCI/TLS, latency/scalability, audit trail, CSRF, session timeout) and a notification webhook with idempotency.

workflows.name: Platform endpoints, base URLs, versioning & data format
workflows.description: Validate the published base URLs, /v2 API versioning, and JSON (application/json) interaction expectations as documented for the portal and API.
workflows.rationale: Multiple explicitly stated interface contracts: base API URL with /v2, portal URL, OpenAPI 3.1 compliance, and JSON data format; coverage includes positive reachability plus contract-level negatives (wrong version/base).

workflows.name: API Gateway protections & WebSocket live transaction feed connectivity
workflows.description: Verify externally observable behaviors for the rate-limited/WAF-protected gateway and basic WebSocket connection behavior for the live transaction feed endpoint.
workflows.rationale: Architecture touchpoints list two separately testable integration surfaces (gateway and WebSocket endpoint); limited explicit behavioral detail, so keep to reachability/connectivity and documented limits where provided elsewhere.

workflows.name: User registration (POST /v2/auth/register) validations & outcomes
workflows.description: Register a new user and validate all documented field constraints plus the 201/400/409/422 outcome matrix and email verification trigger.
workflows.rationale: 8 required fields with specific validation rules + 4 distinct response codes/conditions including uniqueness and password complexity; breadth requires at least one positive and representative negatives per error path.

workflows.name: Login & token issuance (POST /v2/auth/login) including lockout and rate limit
workflows.description: Authenticate user credentials and validate optional inputs, success tokens, invalid credentials, account lock after failed attempts, and login rate limiting behavior.
workflows.rationale: Documented outcome matrix includes 200/401/403/429 plus decision thresholds (5 failed attempts lock, 10 req/min per IP); also includes optional fields (mfa_code, device_id, remember_me) impacting behavior (refresh TTL).

workflows.name: Token refresh rotation (POST /v2/auth/token/refresh)
workflows.description: Validate refresh token single-use rotation behavior and 200/401 outcomes for expired or already used tokens.
workflows.rationale: Critical security control with explicit rotation and single-use requirement plus two outcome codes; requires coverage for valid refresh, replay/used token, and expiry/invalid cases.

workflows.name: Portal session storage constraints (cookies vs localStorage) & inactivity timeout UX
workflows.description: Validate that auth tokens are stored in HttpOnly/Secure cookies (not localStorage) and that portal sessions expire after 15 minutes inactivity with a 2-minute warning modal before logout.
workflows.rationale: Two high-risk portal-level security behaviors explicitly stated (cookie storage constraint and session timeout with warning modal); needs coverage across normal flow, inactivity boundary, and persistence expectations.

workflows.name: Credit application multi-step flow sequencing & autosave draft
workflows.description: Validate that the credit application is submitted across three sequential API calls with ordering enforced and autosave every 60 seconds to localStorage.
workflows.rationale: Multi-step workflow with cross-step dependency (session_token issued in step 1 and required for steps 2 and 3) plus autosave behavior; requires positive end-to-end and negative sequencing/missing artifact coverage.

workflows.name: Application Step 1 — Personal Information (POST /v2/applications/start)
workflows.description: Initiate application and validate Step 1 required fields, address schema constraints, and 201/400/409 outcomes including DUPLICATE_APPLICATION behavior.
workflows.rationale: Multiple field constraints (name length, email match, E.164 phone, address sub-fields, enum id_type, id_number format) plus 3 response outcomes; includes identity and duplication control.

workflows.name: Application Step 2 — Financial Information (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/financials)
workflows.description: Submit financial information with required X-App-Session header, validate field constraints including conditional employer_name, and verify PENDING_REVIEW response with fico_pull_id and error outcomes.
workflows.rationale: Cross-step dependency (application_id + session_token header exp 30 min) + multiple validations (income max, defaults, Decimal(10,2), consent must be true) + three outcome codes (200/400/401).

workflows.name: Application Step 3 — Decision & Card Selection (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/submit)
workflows.description: Finalize application and validate decision branches for the documented FICO bands and signature requirement error behavior.
workflows.rationale: Outcome matrix has three distinct 200 decisions driven by credit score thresholds plus a 400 error branch for missing/malformed e_signature; includes dependency on card_product_id reference.

workflows.name: Initiate transaction / web payment (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Authorize and post web-initiated transactions validating required fields, formatting constraints, and all documented approval/decline/error outcomes including frequency limit behavior.
workflows.rationale: High-branch outcome matrix (two 200 variants plus 402/403/422/429) and many input constraints (amount >0, merchant fields, MCC, currency/exchange rate conditional, enum type); includes user-ownership constraint.

workflows.name: List transactions (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Retrieve paginated transaction history and validate query parameter rules including date range, pagination limits, category filtering, and forbidden access for non-owned accounts.
workflows.rationale: Documented constraints: from/to date relation, defaults, page/per_page min/max, category enum, plus 200/400/403 outcomes; requires pagination and access control coverage.

workflows.name: Foreign transaction fee calculation (REQ-006)
workflows.description: Validate the documented foreign transaction CAD total formula and separate foreign_fee_amount itemization for currency_code ≠ CAD.
workflows.rationale: One explicit numeric formula with separate response field requirement; coverage needs golden-value and boundary/precision checks and conditional application when currency_code is not CAD.

workflows.name: Get account summary (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/summary)
workflows.description: Retrieve account balances/limits/status and validate include_rewards default behavior and owner-only access (403 FORBIDDEN).
workflows.rationale: Single endpoint with query param default plus access control branch; includes key account state outputs used by other workflows.

workflows.name: Freeze/Unfreeze card status (PATCH /v2/cards/{card_id}/status)
workflows.description: Update card status between Active and Frozen with OTP confirmation, validate invalid transition handling, OTP failure behavior, and audit logging mention for reason.
workflows.rationale: State transition rules (only {Active, Frozen}) + OTP requirement + outcome matrix (200/400/401) and explicit audit logging note for reason; requires valid transitions and invalid attempts.

workflows.name: Report card lost/stolen (POST /v2/cards/{card_id}/report-lost)
workflows.description: Block a card and trigger re-issue workflow, validate irreversibility and ALREADY_BLOCKED behavior, and optional investigation/mailing inputs.
workflows.rationale: Irreversible state change with explicit 200 and 409 outcomes plus enum loss_type and optional datetime/address fields; needs idempotent-like repeat call behavior validation via 409.

workflows.name: Set/reset card PIN (PUT /v2/cards/{card_id}/pin)
workflows.description: Set or reset the virtual PIN validating 4-digit format, PIN match, OTP requirement reference, and blocked-card refusal.
workflows.rationale: Security-sensitive flow with encryption expectation (RSA-OAEP), strict format constraints, and outcome matrix (200/400/403); includes dependency on OTP source endpoint reference.

workflows.name: Get statement (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/statements/{statement_id}) including format JSON/PDF
workflows.description: Retrieve a billing statement in JSON or PDF and validate the 200 payload keys plus 404 NOT_FOUND behavior for missing/not-generated statements.
workflows.rationale: Documented content keys (interest, fees, rewards, due date) and output format variations (JSON/PDF) plus 404 branch; statement is core financial artifact.

workflows.name: Billing: Interest calculation (REQ-009, ADB method)
workflows.description: Validate interest charged is computed using the documented ADB/APR/days formula for a billing cycle.
workflows.rationale: One explicit calculation formula that impacts regulated financial correctness; requires at least golden-value, rounding/precision, and boundary day-count coverage.

workflows.name: Billing: Grace period eligibility (REQ-010)
workflows.description: Validate the 21-day grace period is applied only when prev_statement_balance_paid_in_full is true.
workflows.rationale: Binary decision rule with a single predicate; requires both branches (eligible/ineligible).

workflows.name: Billing: Late fee trigger (REQ-011)
workflows.description: Validate late_fee is $35.00 only when payment_received_date is greater than due_date + 2 days.
workflows.rationale: Time-threshold decision rule with boundary at due_date+2; requires before/at/after boundary coverage and value assertion ($35.00).

workflows.name: Billing: Rewards accrual and rounding (REQ-012, REQ-013)
workflows.description: Validate rewards accrual multipliers for Travel MCC vs all other, and enforce floor() rounding behavior (never round/ceil).
workflows.rationale: Two related numeric rules with category-based multiplier plus rounding directive; needs at least one test per category and rounding edge values to prove floor behavior.

workflows.name: Statement accuracy tolerance (REQ-015)
workflows.description: Validate statement total_spend equals sum(transaction_amount[]) within the documented tolerance of ±$0.01.
workflows.rationale: One explicit reconciliation rule with an explicit tolerance; needs at least within-tolerance pass and outside-tolerance fail/flag behavior (as observable).

workflows.name: Make a payment (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/payments) including scheduling
workflows.description: Submit payments from linked bank accounts and validate amount constraints, payment_type enum, scheduled vs immediate behavior, and 200/400/422 outcomes.
workflows.rationale: Multiple constraints (min $1.00, max=total_balance) + enum types + optional scheduled_date branching + outcome matrix including BELOW_MINIMUM and INVALID_BANK_ACCOUNT; also depends on pre-linked bank accounts reference.

workflows.name: Data masking of PAN in browser (REQ-014)
workflows.description: Verify PAN is displayed masked as **** **** **** 1234 and that full PAN is never transmitted to or rendered in the frontend/DOM.
workflows.rationale: Explicit compliance requirement with both display format and transmission prohibition; requires UI and network/DOM inspection test points.

workflows.name: Right to rescind account (REQ-016 DELETE /v2/accounts/{{id}} timebox)
workflows.description: Validate account rescission endpoint availability for 14 days post-issuance, rejection after Day 14, and no membership fee as stated.
workflows.rationale: Regulatory/time-bound rule with a strict boundary (Day 14 vs after) plus constraint of no membership fee; needs boundary-time coverage.

workflows.name: PCI-DSS L1 web controls: TLS 1.3 and iframe tokenisation (NFR-01)
workflows.description: Validate that forms transmit over TLS 1.3 and card fields use iframe tokenisation with no raw PAN in the DOM.
workflows.rationale: Explicit security NFR with two observable web properties (TLS version and iframe tokenisation / DOM constraints); requires at least positive assertions for both.

workflows.name: Performance: API p95 latency target (NFR-02)
workflows.description: Assess whether API p95 latency meets the stated ≤ 1,500 ms target under defined test load profiles.
workflows.rationale: One explicit percentile-based threshold; requires at least baseline and stressed-but-controlled load validations to confirm p95 compliance.

workflows.name: Performance: Portal Time-to-Interactive target (NFR-02)
workflows.description: Validate portal Time-to-Interactive is ≤ 3s on 4G as stated.
workflows.rationale: Explicit frontend performance threshold with network condition; requires at least cold-load and repeat-load measurements under 4G throttling.

workflows.name: Scalability & autoscaling trigger requirements (NFR-03)
workflows.description: Validate the system can sustain 5,000 concurrent requests/sec at the API gateway and that autoscaling triggers at 70% CPU utilization (as observable in the environment).
workflows.rationale: Two explicit scalability requirements (throughput and autoscaling trigger); requires performance/infrastructure-observable validations, typically in staging with telemetry access.

workflows.name: Audit trail for credit_limit changes (NFR-04)
workflows.description: Verify that all credit_limit changes produce an immutable audit log entry containing user_id, session_id, ip_address, and timestamp_utc.
workflows.rationale: Explicit compliance logging requirement with four required fields and immutability property; requires generation and verification of audit records (with appropriate access).

workflows.name: CSRF protection and SameSite=Strict cookie policy (NFR-05)
workflows.description: Validate that all state-changing endpoints require X-CSRF-Token and that SameSite=Strict cookie policy is enforced.
workflows.rationale: Two explicit web security requirements spanning multiple endpoints; requires representative state-changing calls (e.g., register/login excluded vs others) to validate enforcement and cookie attribute behavior.

workflows.name: Notification webhook idempotent delivery (POST /v2/notifications/webhook)
workflows.description: Validate notification webhook request validations, enum constraints, and idempotency behavior returning DUPLICATE_NOTIFICATION for duplicate idempotency_key.
workflows.rationale: Explicit fields with multiple enums + max length constraint + idempotency key semantics with 200/400/409 outcome matrix; includes duplicate suppression as concurrency/idempotency pattern.
